notes.title: Tokyo Necro Releases 03 / 13 / 23!
notes.notes:
In a cyberpunk dystopia, Tokyo is frozen over and riddled with the undead, and it falls to the members of a Living Dead Stalker Agency to do the dirty work of cleaning up the streets.

Tokyo Necro, brought to you by Nitro Origin (formerly Nitroplus), the sister company of Togainu No Chi’s NITRO CHiRAL, is the latest and greatest in action visual novels. Gorgeous art transitions into 3D models during fully animated fight scenes, making this one of the most graphically intensive visual novels ever made. And those graphics aren't just for show either, underpinning a gripping narrative set within a vivid locale offering the same kind of brilliant worldbuilding that made Togainu No Chi so unique.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183070/Tokyo_Necro
Be sure to wishlist it before it goes on sale on Monday the 13th!
